reviews.title: Perfect Automated Email Marketing Platform
reviews.pros: Klaviyo is one of the very software that ticks all the boxes for our customer relationship and marketing automation needs. It helped us to build highly engaging campaigns. It's analytics is very robust, gives us the ability to drop emails to the right subscriber. The user interface is visually clean and appealing.
reviews.cons: It supports less platform for integration as compared to other software.
reviews.overall: Overall, Klaviyo turns out to be a very value-for-money platform for us. It is easy to use. The customer support is excellent and the deployment process was smooth.  Overall it's great software that helps to increase sales.

reviews.title: Perfect for Business
reviews.pros: Klaviyo is perfect for any type of business. With it's easy integration with Shopify and automation for order fulfilment and abandoned checkouts.
reviews.cons: Templates can be hard to set up, but once you've learnt how to use the user interface, it can be worked through a breeze.
reviews.overall: I am super happy with Klaviyo and would not look for any alternative. It is perfect for any e-commerce store and builds a professional look to my business.

reviews.title: Worth the Cost, Easy ROI
reviews.pros:
Simple to use interface with many robust features. Can be done at your own will, or have a team behind your email campaigns to maximize returns.

Data feels secure and never downtime issues.
reviews.cons: It involves training heavily to get used to what Klaviyo can do. However, there are many training resources to help assist your email campaigns.
reviews.overall: Klaviyo has helped boost email marking efforts and help retain and grow new subscribers.

reviews.title: Helpful email tool but also pricey
reviews.pros: A powerful email platform, their templates and starter flows are good to get started with initial email sequences. Their editor is pretty good and I like their integrations into Shopify for things like coupon codes, cart abandonment emails etc.
reviews.cons: Can sometimes be a little bit hard to use and setup, but once you understand the nuances it is fine. The platform is expensive based on newsletter subscriber volume as compared to other platforms, in some ways it may be best to hire someone to manage it to get the most value out of it.
reviews.overall: A very powerful email marketing platform, good templates and sequences as well as integrations with platforms like Shopify. However given the strength of the platform it is expensive.

reviews.title: Klaviyo Insight
reviews.pros:
Ease of implementing and laying Klaviyo to email marketing procedures was what I first liked. 

Sending thousands of outbound emails is another great aspect.
reviews.cons: Pricing is a bit high, although our organization is able to cater for everything.
reviews.overall: My overall encounter with Klaviyo is great since, I haven't faced tons of issues, and has enabled us to generate high leads.

reviews.title: It makes it all better when it comes to email marketing and e-commerce
reviews.pros: I like Klaviyo and how well it syncs with other tools, especially e-commerce and other marketing platforms, to make it easy to pull data from the media it integrates with, facilitate segmentation, create automated flows and strengthen email marketing in our organization. It simplifies everything about email marketing, is very easy to use, has good templates, automation, and more.
reviews.cons: Some functions are somewhat complicated to understand; you need to dig a lot in tutorials; this can make adapting to the software more difficult.
reviews.overall: We have integrated it into our Shopify e-commerce store successfully, and it has made everything easier. Klaviyo makes pulling data from our e-commerce platform and other marketing tools very quick and easy, plus its ability to monitor revenue, optimize flows, and email marketing processes saves time and energy for our entire marketing team. Our experience using Klaviyo has been quite satisfactory; its smooth integration and other tools make life easier for my organization's marketing team.

reviews.title: Email marketing is no longer difficult with Klaviyo
reviews.pros: The main advantage is that it segments a formidable amount of users to apply promotional and marketing methods. It has email autoresponder tools that we can pre-build and import to your database to automate customer relationships.
reviews.cons: However, it does not offer customer survey options to determine what their needs are and to target our opportunities with them. On the other hand, to have a greater scope of access to contacts in your database you must pay subscriptions that depend on the number of users provided, but their costs are very high compared to other applications.
reviews.overall: Although a large investment must be provided to exploit its functionalities, Klaviyo is a tool that allows extending market relationships between users and companies with its message automation and persistent contact with customers to cover all their needs. Klaviyo is an essential tool in advertising.

reviews.title: Klaviyo Review
reviews.pros: I love Klaviyo. It has been very easy to learn and is very convenient. With being an intern for an advertising agency I 100% recommend this software.
reviews.cons: I've run into problems when making creative emails and incorporating certain gradients of colors.
reviews.overall: Overall, Klaviyo is very easy to use and is very useful for the agency that I am interning for. I recommend using this software when designing templates such as creative emails.
